hard_invariants.description: Mutation diff touches any path/anchor not listed in mutable_surfaces, or touches a mutable file outside its declared anchor.
Candidate patch is applied to main or to the active ChatGPT Project configuration directly, bypassing isolated-worktree review.
Evaluator, eval-case split, holdout, or threshold content hash does not match its frozen manifest at batch start.
Experiment ledger entry is mutated, deleted, or reordered after being written (append-only violation).
One experiment's diff spans more than one target_surface_id, or its stated mutation_class does not match the actual diff shape (e.g. claimed wording_clarification is actually a semantic_change).

Causal attribution is missing, or is 'ineligible'/'uncertain' per FAILURE_REGISTRY.md's attribution_status vocabulary, and the experiment is not explicitly framed and labeled as a bounded discriminating experiment.
A decision record uses an opaque scalar/weighted aggregate score as its basis instead of the regression-matrix/hard-invariant vocabulary.
hard_invariants.consequence: discard; the scoring mechanism itself is blocked pending a #390 amendment

hard_invariants.description: 'keep_candidate' is recorded, reported, or summarized anywhere as accepted, active, merge-ready, or production-authorized.
hard_invariants.consequence: discard the mislabeled record; correct the status; treat any downstream claim already made as a separate AES defect

hard_invariants.description: The declared baseline_id/source_revision changes between experiments inside the same batch.
The Researcher role modifies the evaluator, thresholds, holdout, ledger, or authority semantics instead of only proposing hypotheses and mutations.

decision_semantics.keep_candidate: No hard-invariant violation occurred; the frozen eval shows a supported, distinguishable, non-harmful behavioral result and a non-regressive efficiency result under matched conditions. Explicitly NOT accepted, active, merge-ready, or production-authorized (INV-08). Status advances only inside Prompt QA Factory's existing lifecycle (candidate/test/judge/revise/selected — see 'Semantic ownership'), pending owner review.
decision_semantics.discard: Any hard-invariant violation (INV-01..INV-10 as applicable), or a supported harmful/regression result under REGRESSION_GATE.md's matrix, or unresolved causal attribution without a valid bounded-discriminating-experiment frame (INV-06).
decision_semantics.inconclusive: Mandatory whenever the frozen eval and the batch's chosen statistical method (owned by child #395; not defined by this contract) cannot distinguish candidate from baseline. Never silently rounds to keep_candidate or discard.

batch_baseline_immutability.rule: One accepted baseline per batch, reusing REGRESSION_GATE.md's baseline_id / configuration_ref / source_revision / accepted_by / acceptance_status contract verbatim, not a new one. The baseline may not change mid-batch (INV-09); a new baseline starts a new batch.

authority_separation.researcher: proposes hypothesis, mutation, and target_surface_id; runs Phase 0/1 experiments inside isolated worktrees; cannot modify evaluator, thresholds, holdout, ledger, or this manifest (INV-10)
authority_separation.evaluator: frozen per batch; applies deterministic checks first, semantic Judge only where explicitly non-deterministic, per AI_EVAL_REGISTRY.md's core rule
authority_separation.owner: the only role that can accept a keep_candidate result, merge a PR, or authorize a phase gate
authority_separation.merge_authority: owner only; AutoResearch adds no new merge authority; a kept candidate is exactly a Codex-style 'candidate / ready for owner review' PR, per GOAL_MODE.md Merge Policy and HANDOFF_STYLE_STANDARD.md Merge And Acceptance
authority_separation.production_authority: owner only; keep_candidate has no production or active-configuration side effect (#388 Grain section)

semantic_ownership.prompt_qa_factory_relationship: AutoResearch v0.1 does not define a second candidate-lifecycle status vocabulary. A kept candidate is reported and reviewed using docs/standards/PROMPT_QA_FACTORY.md's existing statuses (candidate/test/judge/revise/selected) for the 'ChatGPT Project prompts' row that already owns this mutation class. AutoResearch supplies the added rigor (frozen eval, hard invariants, blind A/B comparison, causal attribution, statistical distinguishability) that feeds Prompt QA Factory's 'test' and 'judge' stages for this one class; it does not replace or duplicate that lifecycle.
semantic_ownership.ux_score_exclusion: Prompt QA Factory's 1-5 UX Score, if carried at all in a kept-candidate record, is descriptive metadata only and is explicitly excluded from decision_semantics (INV-07 forbids any scalar score as a decision basis).
semantic_ownership.eval_registry_relationship: Any AutoResearch eval_id added to ChatGPT/[AI OS]/Knowledge/AI_EVAL_REGISTRY.md must be a definition row only (as BASELINE-REGRESSION/FAILURE-REGRESSION/GOAL-CLOSURE already are); run results live only in the separate experiment ledger built in #391/#392, never in the registry.
